Completely OPAQUE FLAT PURE #FF00FF magenta background, no transparency requested, no floor/shadow/scene/text/labels/grid.
INTERPOLATION TARGET: 75 percent from A toward B; clearly close to B with only one small quarter-step remaining. Left-column swinging boot nearly reaches the passing pose shown in B; right-column advancing heel hovers just before its forward landing shown in B. Preserve correct near/far support leg in each pair.
